transcript: Yesterday I saw The Half God of rainfall at New York Theatre Workshop. A play that tells the mythical story of Demi, 1/2 god and basketball star. It's also the story of the abuse his mother endured under Zeus, the sky and thunder god. Structured and narrated like an epic, The Half God of rainfall is performed by an ensemble of 7 who assume various roles throughout the peace. There were times where I found it hard to follow the consistent switching between dialogue and direct narration, but the story still shines through and the performances are passionate and the transitions between characters are seamless. Also, the design elements are very cool, especially the stage which is covered in a coarse sand and has a drainage system for when. Spoiler alert it rains with that. Another program for my collection.
